subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] JBF submission package ready: leverage-direction (Paper 1) — 可一鍵 submit
body:
Alert level: info
Title: JBF submission package ready: leverage-direction (Paper 1) — 可一鍵 submit

# JBF Submission Package — Leverage Direction Matters

**Author**: Yi-Hao Lai (Da-Yeh University)
**Target**: Journal of Banking and Finance
**Submission portal**: https://www.editorialmanager.com/jbf/
**Editor**: Christa H.S. Bouwman (Managing Editor, Mays Business School, Texas A&M)
**Decision basis**: `paper/leverage-direction/decision_2026_06_05.md` — submit-first 路徑
**Package prep**: hourly-13 (2026-06-24)

---

## 1. Files to upload — final artifact list

| Slot | File | Size (bytes) | Pages | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Manuscript (main) | `paper/leverage-direction/main.pdf` | 279,238 | 49 | `a09e9e55c6f7146d875da4b0bdbc133c5b4a223262afa57916ff9d9574032936` |
| Cover letter | `paper/leverage-direction/cover_letter.pdf` | 25,347 | 2 | `b6f0122fae3727e7acb5db0d08a54d125a419621dce27bb10338e971e9530af3` |
| Highlights | `paper/leverage-direction/highlights.txt` | 831 | — | `9fd2938ece4b238ac5f20c835021af417c56fcc14aa2b63f6bed96ed254f07b3` |
| Graphical abstract | `paper/leverage-direction/graphical_abstract.pdf` | 35,660 | 1 | `44f07030399e8761ffa2b8c2bec794fdc113fc8f81aae470ecb845212bf55f75` |
| Supplementary | `paper/leverage-direction/supplementary.pdf` | 82,621 | 9 | `aed0c49990e5e0ce7436c5be2ce5adc17bd01605f12e2390d8b800f5a73960d0` |
| Data sources statement | `paper/leverage-direction/data_sources.md` | 4,350 | — | `6c3a6fb75d6eb70df9bab547914291d55e5ccc00e0dc3d939a00aec930cbcf3b` |

**重點變動本 tick**：
- `cover_letter.pdf` 重編讓 `\today` 更新為 2026-06-24（內容無實質變動，只刷日期）
- `highlights.txt` 修正第 1 條（gold leverage K903 sign-flip）對齊 body + cover letter（避免 reviewer 第一眼看到 stale `t = -5.79` claim 被質疑）

---

## 2. Suggested reviewers (cover letter §inline)

| # | Name | Affiliation | Expertise |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Peter R. Hansen | UNC Chapel Hill | Volatility model comparison, GARCH forecast evaluation |
| 2 | Alan Moreira | University of Rochester (Simon) | Volatility-managed portfolios |
| 3 | Dirk G. Baur | University of Western Australia | Gold safe-haven dynamics, cross-asset volatility |

**Excluded reviewers**: 無已知 personal / co-author conflict — 留空。

---

## 3. JBF Submission Checklist

- [x] Manuscript anonymized? — **NO** (JBF 非 double-blind，作者資訊保留)
- [x] Cover letter addressed to Editor (Christa Bouwman)
- [x] Highlights ≤ 85 chars / bullet × 5 (本檔 5 條, 修正後與 body 一致)
- [x] Graphical abstract (PDF + PNG)
- [x] Manuscript ≤ JBF soft limit (49 pp, well within ~50)
- [x] Suggested reviewers ≥ 3
- [x] Data availability statement → `data_sources.md` + body §Data
- [x] No prior submission elsewhere (cover letter line 39)
- [x] Author affiliation + email in cover letter
- [ ] **JBF online portal upload** ← needs boss login (Elsevier Editorial Manager)
- [ ] **R&R-deferred items acknowledged in cover letter**: C3 Table 5 K899 unified VaR ✅ (cover letter line 37)

---

## 4. Reserved-for-R&R caveat

Cover letter explicitly flags one revision-round item:
> Table 5 currently draws on three separate experiments (K799, K802, K824v2). A unified VaR specification (experiment K899) ... is reserved for the revision round per the typical robustness expectations of the journal.

Decision memo `decision_2026_06_05.md` 採此路徑：reviewer C3 質疑歸 R&R round，**不阻擋本輪 submission**。

---

## 5. 下一步（需 boss 親自做）

1. 登入 https://www.editorialmanager.com/jbf/
2. 依上方表格逐 slot upload artifact
3. Suggested / excluded reviewer fields 照 §2 填入
4. Submit → 拿 manuscript ID (e.g., `JBF-D-26-XXXXX`) → 回信給 AI 寫入 `paper/leverage-direction/submission_history.json`

**本任務範圍止於 prep；upload + click submit 由 boss 執行**（per task description line 「實際 click-submit by boss」）。
